def restore_garland(n, main_lamps):
    # Create a list to store the connections
    connections = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    # The lamp connected to the grid will be the one with the highest index
    grid_lamp = max(main_lamps)
    
    # Create a dictionary to map main lamps to their auxiliary lamps
    main_to_aux = {}
    
    # Initialize the auxiliary lamps for each main lamp
    for main_lamp in main_lamps:
        main_to_aux[main_lamp] = []

        main_lamp = main_lamps[i]

        connections[main_lamp].append(aux_lamp)
        main_to_aux[main_lamp].append(aux_lamp)
    
    # Construct the final scheme
    scheme = [grid_lamp]

        current_main = main_lamp
